textos.texto.t:
It is a pleasure to welcome you to the world of ithos.

We are a small family workshop, in Castelo Branco, where wood comes to life through our hands, giving rise to unique night lights, handcrafted one by one, to illuminate children's bedrooms.
Each piece is born from a love of detail, the beauty of natural shapes, and the desire to create special objects, designed to accompany childhood with delicacy, warmth, and personality.

We invite you to discover our universe, at your own pace. We hope you find a piece here that touches your heart and that, one day, becomes part of a beautiful story.
